messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: methylKit: v0.4 amendment
parts:
Hi,
If you have downloaded and installed methylKit yesterday. Please
re-download and re-install.
This amendment is fixing a possible issue occurring when using
multiple-cores for differential methylation calculation using Fisher's
Exact test.
Whether you make this update for v0.4 or not the results you get from
Fisher's Exact test will be same as before (the version released
yesterday or v0.3.1). But if you use multiple-cores, the calculations
will be faster.

http://code.google.com/p/methylkit/
